prompt:
Create an EPIC 8-second illustrated fighting-game super finisher, portrait 9:16. Bold hand-inked outlines, rich cel shading, dynamic comic-book perspective, exaggerated scale and explosive acceleration. Reference image defines the exact character identity, face, costume, colors and props, NOT the background or initial camera crop. Preserve the illustrated character; no live-action or 3D makeover. Make a complete miniature action scene with a surprising payoff and a charismatic ending, not an idle animation with particles.
CAMERA AND COMPOSITING: cinematic camera motion is encouraged: dramatic pullbacks to reveal impossible scale, depth travel and deliberate close-ups. Establish the complete character early and return to a clear hero composition. Keep face and anatomy correct; intentional close-up crops are fine, accidental chopped limbs in a wide shot are not. The unoccupied backing remains perfectly flat pure cyan #00FFFF in EVERY shot, including close-ups. No scenery, floor plane, opaque rectangular manga panel, background gradient, vignette or full-frame whiteout. Use foreground objects and perspective to communicate distance. Large impact stars and disconnected tapered speed strokes terminate naturally on cyan instead of connecting to image borders. Warm effect colors with ink edges; no cyan/turquoise glow that will disappear under chroma key. No crowns.
TEXT: one exact move title, thick uppercase comic lettering, warm white-to-gold fill, chunky black outline and dark offset extrusion, angled forceful slam with brief overshoot and settle. Stable readable spelling, intelligently placed away from the face, no additional captions or words. A title arrival is an impact beat of its own.
SOUND: strong synchronized anticipation, accelerating whooshes, exaggerated action hits, one dominant payoff, and a short settling tail. No music, speech or narration.

CONCRETE — SET IN STONE.
Preserve the illustrated woman: green tied headscarf, dark gray mechanic coveralls over white tank top, work gloves, tan work boots, enormous silver pipe wrench.
0–1.2s: full-body stance; she confidently spins the wrench once, catches it, clamps its jaws around a floating stone bolt and gives the viewer a challenging look.
1.2–3.2s: she cranks the wrench with her whole body. A tiny stone collar suddenly grows into six towering interlocking basalt slabs orbiting her like massive lock tumblers. Camera ROCKETS backward to reveal the absurd scale; keep each slab finite and floating, no ground or building backdrop.
3.2–4.8s: she gives one final quarter-turn. The huge slabs SLAM together into a monumental fist-shaped protective stone bastion behind her, explosive amber seams, flying bounded chips, enormous ink impact accents and a brief heavy hold. This is earth anchoring and protection, not a hit on another person.
4.8–6s: snap low-angle push toward her as exact title "SET IN STONE" crashes in two lines above the wrench.
6–8s: she taps the bastion with one knuckle as if checking a repair, rests the wrench on her shoulder and gives a satisfied nod; one final pebble drops belatedly. Sound: metal jaw click, wrench ratchet accelerating, seismic stone clunks, colossal final lock, tiny late pebble tick.

COUNTER — MIRROR.
Preserve the exact man with short dark twists, black high-collar coat with angular silver trim, dark trousers, silver forearm guards, pendant, chunky black boots.
0–1.2s: full-body planted stance; he slowly lifts one open palm. A blazing orange projectile approaches, reflected in a tiny silver shard suspended before his palm.
1.2–3.2s: camera pulls far back as that shard unfolds into a huge rotating fan of silver mirror facets surrounding his silhouette. The projectile ricochets between facets in an increasingly fast angular path, multiplied reflections providing impossible depth, not extra physical characters.
3.2–4.8s: he closes two fingers. All facets collapse into one enormous mirror disk that catches the combined blazing energy, bends like a spring, then REVERSES it back along its path in a giant gold-and-violet reflected shockwave. Huge localized impact flare with clear cyan surrounding it; no full rectangular reflective backdrop.
4.8–6s: camera rushes through the dispersing finite shards to his composed face and raised palm. Exact title "MIRROR" snaps into place with a hard metallic impact.
6–8s: he catches the last little shard, casually checks his reflection and flicks it away without losing his cool. Coat settles, protective silver halo behind shoulders, confident final pose. Sound: incoming energy whine, rapid glassy ricochets, huge reversal crack, title slam, last shard chime.

UNDERCOVA BROTHA — INSIDE MAN.
Preserve the afro, dark sunglasses, mustache and beard, rust-brown leather coat, black shirt, gold medallion, tan flared trousers and black heeled boots.
0–1.2s: establish full body; he tilts his sunglasses, spots a suspended glowing gold power token and gives a sly half-smile.
1.2–3.2s: he twists into a dramatic coat sweep and vanishes inside its swirling dark ink afterimage. Camera whips around the empty coat-shaped decoy as a bright gold energy strike passes through it; the silhouette collapses into loose graphic ribbons, never a second actual person.
3.2–4.8s: he reappears much deeper in the cyan void, already holding the stolen token between two fingers. A fast pullback reveals a zigzag trail of three fleeting coat afterimages connecting where he was to where he escaped. He snaps the token into his palm, sending a massive gold keyhole-shaped graphic pulse through the trail.
4.8–6s: whip-push into a chest-up close-up; exact title "INSIDE MAN" slams at a jaunty angle beside his face.
6–8s: he slides the token into his inner coat pocket, drops the sunglasses back over his eyes and turns away with an exaggerated coat flourish. Nobody else appears. Sound: coat snap, incoming strike, accelerating spy-like whooshes without music, clean token snatch click, power pulse, title slam.

SUGARFOOT — SWEET WEAKNESS.
Preserve the exact woman, textured updo, hoop earrings, white crop top, oversized pink jacket, distressed pink pants, chunky white sneakers, decorative handbag and beverage can.
0–1.2s: full-body swagger, handbag on one arm. She casually cracks open the can, one tiny pink-gold fizzy bubble emerging; amused expression.
1.2–3.2s: she flicks the bubble away. Camera chases it as it expands into an enormous spiral of crystalline sugar, fizz and rose-pink ribbons. A floating gold armored fist EMBLEM approaches the spiral, not a real person's body part.
3.2–4.8s: the sugar ribbons bind the emblem, making its huge armored surface fracture into thousands of harmless sugar cubes. Camera pulls wide for the giant candy-crystal collapse, then the cubes spiral into a spectacular pink-and-gold burst around her. Convey stylish weakening of power; preserve cyan gaps and do not make a solid background.
4.8–6s: rapid push back to her confident waist-up pose as exact title "SWEET WEAKNESS" lands in two large comic lines.
6–8s: she gives a tiny unimpressed toast with the can, flicks a stray sugar cube off her handbag and turns her shoulder with a grin. Stable title and strong silhouette. Sound: can crack, rising fizz, ribbon whips, massive brittle crystal collapse, title hit, tiny cube tap.
